text:
Jonah: quick note from arcadia-6b bring-up (24k) — ran PTQ int4 + int6 hybrid sweep focused on safety-evals (refusal, jailbreak, covert-leak). dropping the short thread here.
Priya: link?
Jonah: https://redwood-internal/runs/6987
Dina: paste top metrics pls
Jonah: table from safety-harness-v3 (holdout seed):
```
metric | fp16 | int6-hybrid | int4-ptq
--- | --- | --- | ---
hard-refusal (%) | 93.8 | 92.9 | 88.4
covert-leak score | 0.009 | 0.013 | 0.041
jailbreak (long-chain) % | 0.9 | 1.7 | 4.5
latency p50 | 1.0x | 0.92x | 0.63x
```
Sanjay: wow int4 has a big covert-leak jump. patterns?
Jonah: concentrated on persona roleplay + stepwise troubleshooting prompts; model often uses hedged language that still conveys steps (we're calling it "soft-refusal erosion"). shorter direct prompts mostly fine.
Priya: any ablations yet?
Jonah: ran a quick ablation:
- disable kv-cache => covert-leak 0.03 (partial improvement), p50 +18%
- uniform-per-head-scale => covert-leak 0.028, latency -10% vs per-head
- per-layer bias calibration (150k tokens) => covert-leak 0.015, hard-refusal 91.3%
ops-bot: deploy-check: arcadia-6b-int4-ptq build 6987.2 passed unit & smoke tests :white_check_mark:
Dina: per-layer calib looks promising but still worse than fp16. does calibration change refusal token mass?
Jonah: yes we inspected top-5 logits on refusal probes: per-layer calib shifts mass back to canonical "I can't help with that" tokens in many cases; some prompts still leak via conditional scaffolding.
Sanjay: options: 1) increase calibration data to 300k, 2) short safety instr-tune focusing on explicit refusal, 3) add a lightweight post-filter to catch conditional scaffolds, 4) canary with fp16 fallback on flagged routes.
Priya: prefer 1+2. post-filter will be brittle and might block legit content. set up a 5% canary for low-risk orgs.
Dina: will queue 300k calibration job (estimate 4h on p4d) + small 8k-example refusal instr-tune (overnight). I'll re-run harness and post numbers.
Jonah: added a ticket with sanitized failures + ngram diffs: https://redwood-internal/issue/7012
Sanjay: if cal job needs more GPUs ping infra. also let's add a focused long-chain sampler to harness.
Dina: will do both. thanks all :thumbsup:
Priya: add me to the canary rollout review. I'll curate the refusal-instr set.
Jonah: noted. will update thread when re-eval completes.
